title: Restoration Ritual Spell
description: After reaching Restoration skill 90 and completing Good Intentions, Colette Marence directs the player to the Augur of Dunlain in The Midden. The Augur tests the player by stripping their items and summoning ghosts; surviving using only Restoration magic earns the Bane of the Undead spell.

base_facts: I am the Restoration instructor at the College of Winterhold.
The Augur of Dunlain in The Midden holds knowledge of master Restoration spells.
Only those who gain the Augur's approval can learn the deepest Restoration magic.

COLETTE_DIRECTS_TO_AUGUR: I have sent this student to seek the Augur of Dunlain in The Midden for further training.

base_facts: I dwell in The Midden beneath the College of Winterhold.
I test those who seek mastery of Restoration magic.
My test requires surviving ghost attacks using only Restoration spells.

SPEAK_WITH_AUGUR: This mage has come seeking my test of Restoration mastery.
PASS_AUGUR_TEST: This mage has proven worthy and earned the Bane of the Undead spell.
Player survives the Augur's ghost test and receives Bane of the Undead. Quest completes at .
Then, before the first ghost notices you, talk to your follower and trade items to retrieve them.
Unlike other ritual quests, this one grants you the first spell directly rather than as a spell tome.

beats.comment: Player asks Colette about further Restoration training; she directs them to the Augur in The Midden.
Player finds and speaks with the Augur of Dunlain in The Midden and learns about the test.
Player survives the Augur's ghost test and receives Bane of the Undead. Quest completes at stage 200.
